column1: # Lucene 10.5.0 lucene-test-framework: every top-level class of the jar, and what became of it.
# Checked by scripts/check-port-inventory.py --module test-framework (see its docstring for the statuses).
# M14.h batches: h1 util/ suites and generators; h2 store/mockfile; h3 analysis; h4 index infrastructure; h5-h6 format suites; h7 search/geo; h8 stress.

column3: crates/lucene-test-framework/src/analysis/base_token_stream.rs::check_random_data -- M14: newAttributeFactory (the port's attributes are a fixed struct); checkResetException's missing-close half has no counterpart (an AnalyzerTokenStream closes on drop)

its subclasses (TestCollationKeyAnalyzer, TestICUCollationKeyAnalyzer) index collation keys and range-query them through a RandomIndexWriter; the ICU crate tests ICUCollationKeyAnalyzer's keys against Java fixtures directly, and the JDK-collator half has no Rust collator to test
a MockTokenizer over MockUTF16TermAttributeImpl, for tests of UTF-16-encoded term bytes; the port's term attribute always yields the term's UTF-8, so no Rust test can ask for another encoding
a term attribute whose bytes are UTF-16 (MockBytesAnalyzer's); the port's attributes are a fixed struct whose term bytes are always UTF-8, with no attribute factory to swap the implementation in
